doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The 1949 JATP Carnegie Hall recording
summary: The interviewer cites a live Carnegie Hall recording Jones didn't know had been made.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: But, the difference was that this was in the studio, as opposed to being live. I have here a recording you did on September 18th, 1949. The date is called, "Byrd and Prez at Carnegie Hall”
Oh, that was recorded? See, I didn't know that a lot of this was recorded. A lot of those things were recorded without our knowledge.
The band was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Flip Phillips, Prez.
Yeah, Tommy was on that. Was Charlie Shavers on that?
No, it was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Phillips, Hank Jones, Ray Brown and Buddy Rich.
Yeah, that was a JPT thing. You see, some of those… Some of those were recorded. I think I have a whole set of them here.
